paper.title: VIS-Ground: Video Interactive Storytelling with Contextual Grounding
paper.ai_summary: VIS-Ground transforms heterogeneous inputs into executable constraints for interactive video generation by recovering cross-context dependencies and enforcing them through planning, verification, and rendering.
paper.summary: Video interactive storytelling enables viewers to actively steer how a video unfolds. However, once we allow viewers to intervene during generation, a new challenge arises: The viewer's request can have latent dependencies on both the grounding source and the current rendered video state. paper.title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
paper.ai_summary: TerminalHorizon automates long-horizon terminal agent data synthesis by reconstructing environments around omitted work and progressively expanding tasks, yielding substantial gains across coding, production, and reasoning benchmarks.
paper.summary: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks.
